classification.difficultyReason: Requires parameter conditions inferred from reflected semicircle shapes, zero crossings, and the comparison of endpoint and central heights.

inlines.text: The following diagrams show the graph of
for each of the diagrams to occur.

spec.description: Symmetric reflected semicircle with two sharp zeros, a central arch and outer endpoints higher than the central peak; no numeric ticks, endpoint markers or curve arrows.
spec.mathematics: Equation-driven representative shape of |a-sqrt(b-x^2)|, normalized to b=1 and a=0.7 solely for drawing. Construction parameters are not printed givens. Exact zero locations are included as segment endpoints.

answer.short:
$b>0$, $\dfrac{\sqrt b}{2}<a<\sqrt b$.

The outer endpoints are higher than the central peak.
answer.worked:
The nondegenerate arc requires $b>0$. Before reflection, $y=a-\sqrt{b-x^2}$ has endpoint height $a$ and central height $a-\sqrt b$. Two zeros and a reflected central arch require $0<a<\sqrt b$. After reflection, the central peak has height $\sqrt b-a$. The endpoints are higher, so
$$\begin{align*}a&>\sqrt b-a\\2a&>\sqrt b\\a&>\frac{\sqrt b}{2}.\end{align*}$$
Hence $b>0$ and $\dfrac{\sqrt b}{2}<a<\sqrt b$.

spec.description: Two sharp zeros and a central arch whose peak equals the outer endpoint heights. Retain the faint dashed horizontal height guide.
spec.mathematics: Equation-driven representative shape normalized to b=1 and a=0.5 solely for drawing. Endpoints and central peak share height 0.5; no construction numbers appear in the student figure.

answer.short:
$b>0$, $a=\dfrac{\sqrt b}{2}$.

The central peak and outer endpoints have equal heights.
answer.worked:
The nondegenerate arc requires $b>0$. The endpoint height is $a$, and the reflected central peak has height $\sqrt b-a$. The dashed line shows these heights are equal:
$$\begin{align*}a&=\sqrt b-a\\2a&=\sqrt b\\a&=\frac{\sqrt b}{2}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unbroken U-shaped semicircular arc entirely above the x-axis, with its minimum on the positive y-axis.
spec.mathematics: Equation-driven representative shape normalized to b=1 and a=1.5 solely for drawing. No numerical parameters are printed.

answer.short:
$b>0$, $a>\sqrt b$.

The entire lower semicircle stays above the $x$-axis.
answer.worked: The nondegenerate arc requires $b>0$. The graph remains U-shaped because no portion is reflected. Its minimum occurs at $x=0$ and has height $a-\sqrt b$. Since the minimum is above the $x$-axis, $a-\sqrt b>0$, giving $a>\sqrt b$.

spec.description: Downward-curving semicircular arch entirely above the x-axis, with its maximum on the y-axis and positive endpoint heights.
spec.mathematics: Equation-driven representative shape normalized to b=1 and a=-0.5 solely for drawing. No numerical parameters are printed.

answer.short:
$b>0$, $a<0$.

The whole lower semicircle is reflected upwards.
answer.worked: The nondegenerate arc requires $b>0$. The downward-curving arch results from reflecting the whole graph of $y=a-\sqrt{b-x^2}$ upwards. Its original endpoint height is $a$; the reflected endpoints have height $-a>0$. Therefore $a<0$.
